name: Baron Spillway
description: an imp noble of the Ember Wastes who keeps the Slag Falls: a fat crimson imp with curled horns and a waxed moustache, a long heavy cape of cooled black slag with glowing orange cracks, a crown of dripping lava, a little lava fall pouring off one shoulder, smug half-closed yellow eyes, small bat wings, a jewelled toll cup in one claw

poses.stand: hovering grandly on small bat wings, cape draped, the toll cup held out, lava dripping from his crown
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers smugly, stroking his moustache, lava dripping from his crown onto his shoulder

attack.action: sweeps his slag cape and flicks a spray of glowing embers off it forward to the right, smirking

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
